thread:
Maria (AE): Heads-up — Orion Bank POC hitting slow TTFT spikes when concurrency > 16. Customer notices 1–2s baseline then sudden 5–8s tail latency. They want this fixed before next exec demo.

Devin (SE): Thanks — any logs or sample requests?

Maria (AE): Pasted two failing traces from their run this morning. Also they asked about pricing impact if we move them to Dedicated (reserved GPUs) vs Hosted with burst.

Sam (SRE): throwing logs here:
```
[2026-03-19T10:02:12Z] shard-3 ERROR kvcache: miss_rate=0.79 prefill_hits=0.08 queue_len=12 ttft_ms=1900
[2026-03-19T10:02:13Z] shard-3 WARN batcher: window_ms=10 inflight_batches=4 token_workers=48
[2026-03-19T10:02:13Z] shard-3 ERROR serve: 429 client=orion-bank-app request_id=abc123
```

Sam (SRE): Observed pattern: high KV cache miss rate during mixed-length conversations. Each request has large policy doc embedded in prompt (~3k tokens) for some users, short prompts for others. That fragments KV cache and reduces prefill effectiveness.

Devin (SE): That matches my repro locally — when prefix length variance > ~1500 tokens, cache reuse drops. Also our default batch window (10ms) ends up merging long and short requests causing long request head-of-line blocking.

Maria (AE): Ok — customer wants remediation + rough cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted.

Devin (SE): Immediate short-term fixes to propose to customer: 
- apply per-route prefill policy: `prefill_size: 2048` for large-doc flows, keep `prefill_policy: none` for short flows
- enable prefix TTL: `kvcache.prefix_ttl_ms: 30000` to hold hot prefixes across bursts
- isolate long-doc users onto a separate route (route-level batching/queue)
- increase batch_window to 20ms for the long-doc route to reduce head-of-line blocking

Devin (SE): Example route snippet to try: 
```yaml
routes:
  - name: orion-long-docs
    match: header["x-client-flow"] == "long-doc"
    prefill_size: 2048
    kvcache:
      prefix_ttl_ms: 30000
    batch_window_ms: 20
```

Sam (SRE): I'll run a short A/B with isolation on our staging pool. Also will surface per-shard kvcache metrics. Run `redwoodctl node stats --kvcache --shard shard-3` to see miss breakdown.

Alina (Security): Quick note — if we split traffic routes, confirm the customer’s security questionnaire: separate routes still flow through the same VPC endpoint for their Private deployment, right? They asked that routing changes shouldn't change data residency.

Devin (SE): Correct — route-level config only affects the serving control plane, not where GPUs or customer data live. For Private customers the data stays in their VPC. We should add an item to the security Q: "route isolation is config-only; no cross-VPC data movement."

Maria (AE): Pricing ask from customer: they want a 3–6 month estimate if we move the POC to Dedicated to guarantee <500ms P95 for the demo. Any ballpark?

Devin (SE): Ballpark: for their model and expected qps (peak 40 qps, avg 12 qps), Dedicated (1x A100-equivalent pool with autoscale buffer) likely ~ $12k–$18k/month committed. Hosted with manual tuning (route isolation + longer batch windows + prefill) is probably cheaper for short-term POC (~$2k–$5k/month), but not SLA-backed. I'll ask PMM for a more formal quote.

Sam (SRE): Running a quick experiment now: isolate long-docs -> route orion-long-docs, run 30m ramp. If we see miss_rate drop <0.2 and P95 <700ms I'll post results.

deploy-bot: Deployment started for config `orion-long-docs` on staging at 2026-03-19T10:18:05Z.

Sam (SRE): First 10m: miss_rate dropped from 0.79 -> 0.27 on shard-3, P95 improved 5.2s -> 770ms. Still seeing occasional 429s during peaks (queue_len spikes).

Devin (SE): Good signal. Next tweak: reduce token_workers for long-doc route to avoid over-committing IO and limit max_concurrency to 16 for that route. That should reduce 429s.

Maria (AE): Customer follow-up items for the next call:
- have a config patch and staging results to show
- short pricing comparison (hosted tuned vs dedicated committed)
- short bullet for security: route isolation doesn't change data residency

Alina (Security): I'll prepare a one-paragraph clarifying note for the security questionnaire about routing and KMS usage (customer uses customer-managed KMS).

Devin (SE): Action items:
- Sam: finish 60m ramp with route isolation + max_concurrency cap (ETA 2h)
- Devin: draft pricing note and Dedicated sizing ask to PMM (ETA end of day)
- Alina: security note + update questionnaire (ETA EOD)
- Maria: schedule 1hr demo next Tue and include staging results

Maria (AE): Thanks team — I’ll sync with the customer and get back with any new edge cases. :thumbsup:

Sam (SRE): Update after 60m: sustained miss_rate ~0.18, P95 ~640ms, 429s dropped by 90%. Will push numbers to the shared doc.

Maria (AE): Perfect — please add one-line notes about the cost tradeoffs so I can include in the deck.

Devin (SE): Added a short pricing table to the doc and a checklist for route labels.

Maria (AE): Closing the thread for now — will reopen if Orion sees regressions in the demo.
